methods: Read the browser observation records, exact selectors, source bindings, edited form state, closure and restoration evidence; no HTTP/SQL result is credited as browser interaction.

Visually reviewed all 203 saved screenshots through 34 private contact sheets, then inspected 12 focal original frames at full size. Independently decoded actual image dimensions and hashed every original image.

Compared all 203 decoded dimensions with recorded viewports, all 40 lighting entry claim/source identities, all eight programme claim/source matrix entries, and four same-Viewer known/missing receipt pairs.
Re-read prior published manual-verification requirements from commit 5985b7b5ef6a87d9312c9d989e90a2d5be6ac19a; no prior whole-scenario result is promoted by this scoped run.

Every entry records the two-of-three insufficiency explanation and return to a button. The persisted claim has no calculation trace or supported actual range; current forecast source remains forecast. Supported imported-stone +18.4% retains its financial trace. The nonexistent prior lighting variance selector returns neutral unavailable in both locales/all widths.

Forecast total 12,650,000 and imported-stone forecast 2,360,000 remain distinct from historical reconciled actual, quoted price and historical stale supplier offer through reviewed workspace/evidence/rationale/receipt frames. Lighting abstention and unquantified programme premium remain.
